answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded-stake ledge: each agent must lock refundable collateral at the network inlet before it can transact. Minting a thousand ivory fake identities then demands a thousand separate bonds, not one. Misbehavior is slashed, so every forged persona risks real capital, and the attacker pays linearly per identity while honest agents reclaim their deposit, making cheap mass impersonation economically pointless.
